# PolarizationModulatedPhotoresponse

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The dependence of the photocurrent magnitude and dynamics on the ferroelectric polarization state, which can be switched or tuned by applied voltage or light. Provides a controllable memory mechanism that can be programmed, enabling reconfigurable reservoir dynamics for adaptive computing in iNEST.
